title: Gap analysis samples: Healthcare credentialing
source_system: Credentialing platform; AHCA screening tracker; shift schedule; export log
what_it_shows: 25 of about 2,600 credential files: all 25 hold medical and non-medical documents together, with annual TB results and fit tests in the same file; 25 of about 520 2026 H1 clinicians: level 2 clearance before the first shift in all 25, and 1 rescreen due within 60 days not flagged; 25 of about 10,800 2026 H1 shift starts: credentials verified before all 25; the daily credential status export was missing on 2 of 5 sampled days

title: Mailbox and file-share searches for document images and SSN extracts
source_system: Productivity suite content search (SYS-05)
what_it_shows: 212 mailbox messages with Form I-9 document images; warehouse extracts with full SSNs in 14 file-share folders; return-to-work notes for associates emailed to branch managers; credential files emailed to client contacts

title: Gap analysis samples: vendor contracts
source_system: Contract register; vendor contracts
what_it_shows: 20 of 64 contracts with vendors that receive personal information: 7 have security and breach notice terms and name a breach contact; the AI vendors are on marketplace click-through terms

title: External TLS scan
source_system: Scanning tool run by the security analyst
what_it_shows: The career site, the SaaS sign-in pages, the VMS and the integration APIs accept TLS 1.2 or higher; SD-WAN tunnels are encrypted

title: Residence-state report test
source_system: ATS and payroll reporting
what_it_shows: A report of associates by state of residence, as a breach notice scoping step, took 2 days to produce

title: Firewall rule review
source_system: Office and cloud hub firewall rule bases
what_it_shows: The cloud hub rule base denies by default; office firewall rule bases allow all outbound traffic; kiosk segment rules exist at Branches 1-5 only

title: Gap analysis samples: outbound call recordings and critical vulnerability findings
source_system: Contact center platform; MSSP scanning portal
what_it_shows: 20 outbound recruiter softphone recordings: none has a recording announcement; all 41 2026 H1 critical findings traced: 9 closed after the 30-day target, the longest at 74 days

title: Approval records, 2026-09-22
source_system: Audit committee minutes; COO and CEO approval records
what_it_shows: The audit committee received the assessment results; the COO approved the deliverables, the policies and the APATP operating decision; the CEO approved the High-risk treatments, the risk appetite and the FY2027 security budget of $410,000 one-time and $257,000 a year; quarterly cyber reporting is on the committee calendar

title: AI-001 validity and adverse impact analysis, 2026 H1
source_system: ATS applicant and auto-advance data; voluntary self-identification data; vendor feature weights
what_it_shows: Self-identification response rate 61%; recruiter agreement with the score on 200 applicants per division: Light Industrial 83%, Office and Professional 91%; Light Industrial auto-advance impact ratio 0.77 for women against men and 0.79 for Hispanic or Latino against White applicants, both significant; vendor feature weights provided on 2026-08-28

title: AI-002 conversation analysis and transcript review, 2026-02-02 to 2026-08-31
source_system: Text assistant conversation logs and transcripts
what_it_shows: About 31,000 conversations; 22% ended on a knockout answer (lifting 41%, transportation 33%, shift availability 26%) with no recruiter review; completion 81.0% for English-preferring and 57.9% for Spanish-preferring applicants; 4 of 100 reviewed transcripts gave wrong pay or shift information; the vendor keeps transcripts indefinitely

title: AI-003, AI-005 and AI-006 reviews
source_system: ATS job ad history; timekeeping flag queue; vendor correspondence
what_it_shows: 3 of 50 generated job ads had recent-graduate preference language and were edited before posting; 50 anomaly flags from 2026-07: 31 explained by GPS drift at 2 distribution centers and 3 punches deleted by on-site coordinators without client confirmation; the face-match vendor could not provide match error rates by skin tone or age group

title: Control assessment: account management
source_system: IdP, ATS, payroll, E-Verify, VMS and credentialing user exports; POL-02 (2024 and 2026 draft); termination sample 25 of 142; transfer sample 15 of 38; Security Manager and IT Director interviews
what_it_shows: Termination sample of 25 of 142: SSO accounts removed in all 25; 3 of 22 E-Verify accounts and 4 of 28 VMS accounts belonged to staff who had left (departures 2025-11 to 2026-06); termination tickets do not notify the E-Verify or VMS account managers; 4 of 15 sampled transfers kept their prior ATS branch; SSO reviews semi-annual (last 2026-03), and ATS roles, E-Verify, VMS and credentialing client users not reviewed; the kiosk password at 6 branches was not changed when 4 staff who knew it left

title: Control assessment: access enforcement
source_system: ATS role matrix (31 roles); credentialing role export; recruiter-role test account created with COO approval
what_it_shows: The recruiter test account opened Form I-9 document images, E-Verify printouts and consumer reports for all 14 branches; the Healthcare recruiter role opened immunization and physical exam documents; 262 users hold these rights

title: Control assessment: separation of duties
source_system: Payroll role export; payroll register approval log; Director of Payroll and Billing interview
what_it_shows: Payroll duties requiring separation are not documented; 2 payroll specialists hold rights to add associates and change pay rates; associate-entered bank changes take effect with no second check

title: Control assessment: least privilege
source_system: Data warehouse grants; BI role export; backup account roles; query test from an analyst account
what_it_shows: 46 users can query full SSNs and bank account numbers in the warehouse, and the test query returned full values; the 2 backup administrators also hold workload administrator rights

title: Control assessment: remote access
source_system: Remote access configuration; contractor access list; repository and workloads account sign-in logs
what_it_shows: Usage restrictions documented for staff remote access; no connection requirements for the 3 contractor developers; sign-in logs show repository and workloads account access from unmanaged personal laptops

title: Control assessment: literacy training
source_system: Training completion report (96%); phishing results 2025-Q3 to 2026-Q2; course content; 15 staff interviews
what_it_shows: Annual training and quarterly simulations delivered; content not updated after the 2026 H1 pay diversion cases or the 2026 push-relay phishing campaigns reported by the MSSP; no lessons from internal incidents in the content

title: Control assessment: role-based training
source_system: Training matrix; E-Verify tutorial records; interviews with payroll, onboarding and credentialing staff
what_it_shows: E-Verify Tutorial and refreshers complete for all users; no role-based security or privacy training before access or annually for payroll, onboarding, credentialing or MSP staff; lessons from pay diversion cases not used in payroll training

title: Control assessment: event logging
source_system: SIEM source list; SaaS audit capability documentation; storage logging settings
what_it_shows: Event types the ATS, payroll, VMS and credentialing platforms can log were never identified or specified; archive object access and warehouse queries are not logged; no rationale or review of event types; logging coordinated with the MSSP

title: Control assessment: audit record review
source_system: MSSP monthly reports; payroll bank-change and export reports for 2026-07; test bulk export by a test payroll user
what_it_shows: Payroll exports, bank changes, ATS bulk downloads and credentialing access are not reviewed; a test export of 5,000 associate records raised no alert; review level unchanged after the 41 pay diversion cases in 2026 H1; findings that are reviewed are reported

title: Control assessment: audit record generation
source_system: Archive and warehouse logging settings; read of a scanned Form I-9 followed by a log search
what_it_shows: Audit record generation is off for archive object access and warehouse queries; the test read of a scanned 2016 Form I-9 produced no audit record

title: Control assessment: configuration change control
source_system: Change tickets; ATS and payroll change logs; sample of 10 ATS configuration changes in 2026 H1; AI tool settings history
what_it_shows: Infrastructure changes approved, implemented and recorded; SaaS configuration changes not defined as controlled, not recorded, not monitored or reviewed; 6 of 10 sampled ATS changes had no review; the AI auto-advance setting (2025-09-15) and the knockout questions (2026-02-02) were enabled without approval

title: Control assessment: component inventory
source_system: Device management inventory; walk-throughs of HQ, Branch 6 and On-site Program 2; asset sample of 30
what_it_shows: 30 of 30 sampled laptops, phones and kiosks found; the inventory omits the 12 fingerprint clocks and on-site network devices; 2 clocks at On-site Program 2 were not known to IT; data stores holding SSNs, I-9 images, medical information and recordings are not recorded

title: Control assessment: contingency plan
source_system: BIA (P05); draft branch hurricane plan; draft P08 runbooks; IT Director and Director of Payroll and Billing interviews
what_it_shows: No approved contingency plan; the BIA and the P08 runbook drafts set essential functions, recovery objectives, restoration priorities and assigned individuals; no off-cycle manual payroll procedure

title: Control assessment: contingency plan testing
source_system: Restore test record 2026-03 (warehouse); backup plan; restore of one integration platform container from backup during testing
what_it_shows: The contingency plan has never been tested; only the warehouse restore is recorded, with results reviewed; the integration platform restore attempted during testing failed because its secrets were outside the backup scope

title: Control assessment: system backup
source_system: Backup plan; backup job reports for 2026-07; backup account roles
what_it_shows: 30 of 30 July 2026 backup job days successful for the warehouse and integration platform; backups encrypted and write-once; the document archive is replicated only, not backed up; backup administrators also administer the workloads

title: Control assessment: recovery and reconstitution
source_system: Infrastructure templates; recovery procedures (none); integration platform restore attempt
what_it_shows: No recovery or reconstitution procedure; the integration platform could not be restored within its 24-hour RTO during testing

title: Control assessment: identification and authentication
source_system: IdP and ATS associate login settings; kiosk walk-throughs; 2026 H1 pay diversion case files
what_it_shows: Staff accounts unique; branch staff sign in to kiosks with a shared local account at 6 branches; associate accounts rely on SMS codes, and 41 were taken over in 2026 H1

title: Control assessment: MFA for privileged accounts
source_system: Conditional access policy; MFA sign-in tests on 25 of 31 privileged accounts
what_it_shows: All 25 sampled privileged accounts required number-matching MFA

title: Control assessment: authenticator management
source_system: IdP password policy; secrets service inventory; container image and repository scan with the IT Director present (2026-08-26)
what_it_shows: A payroll platform API key with write access to associate bank-account fields was stored in plain text in the integration container image and code repository, unrotated since 2024 and readable by 11 accounts including the 3 contractor developers; reported the same day under the stop-and-notify rule and rotated on 2026-08-27; SMS codes protect associate accounts that can change deposits; the shared kiosk password was not changed when staff who knew it left

title: Control assessment: identity proofing
source_system: I-9 sample of 15 remote hires; onboarding procedure; Onboarding and Compliance Specialist interviews
what_it_shows: Identity evidence collected for all 15 sampled remote hires; no written checklist for validating documents during the remote live video examination and no defined steps for confirming that the person on video matches the documents

title: Control assessment: incident handling
source_system: Draft P08 runbooks; incident log 2025-2026 (sample 10 of 46); 2026 H1 pay diversion case files; MSSP escalation test (simulated impossible-travel sign-in)
what_it_shows: The MSSP called the Security Manager 18 minutes after the simulated sign-in; detection and analysis do not cover SaaS activity; pay diversion cases were handled by payroll as payroll errors; SaaS containment steps not agreed with the payroll and ATS vendors; no lessons-learned records for the 10 sampled incidents

title: Control assessment: incident reporting
source_system: POL-03 (2024 and 2026 draft); draft P08 notification matrix; 15 randomly selected staff interviews
what_it_shows: 4 of 15 interviewed staff, all on-site coordinators, did not know how or how fast to report a suspected incident

title: Control assessment: incident response plan
source_system: POL-03; draft P08 runbooks and notification matrix; distribution list
what_it_shows: The draft runbooks set structure, approach, reportable incidents, resources, information sharing and responsibilities; no metrics for incident response capability; not yet distributed to branch and on-site managers, the payroll vendor or the MSSP contacts named in them; no exercises held

title: Control assessment: media sanitization
source_system: Shredding certificates; asset disposal records 2025-2026 (sample 10 of 37)
what_it_shows: 10 of 10 sampled laptop reuse wipes recorded; 3 kiosks and 2 fingerprint clocks disposed of in 2025 with no sanitization or destruction certificate; no sanitization standard for kiosks, clocks and multifunction devices

title: Control assessment: physical access
source_system: Walk-throughs of HQ, Branch 6, Branch 9 and On-site Program 2; badge logs; key logs
what_it_shows: Badge access, visitor escort and badge logs operate as listed; network closet keys at 3 branches hang in the open supply room; at Branch 9 the lobby kiosk area opens onto the hallway to the network closet; branch keys not changed after 2 branch manager departures in 2026

title: Control assessment: privacy notice
source_system: Career site notice; application flow; text assistant scripts; clock enrollment records; 20 outbound call recordings
what_it_shows: Applicants are not told that an AI tool scores and ranks them or that a text assistant asks screening questions; associates enrolled on fingerprint clocks received no notice; 20 of 20 sampled outbound recruiter calls gave no recording announcement; the FCRA disclosure and the applicant privacy notice are available

title: Control assessment: risk assessment
source_system: P01 risk register and report; audit committee materials
what_it_shows: The SP 800-30 enterprise risk assessment completed 2026-08-07 (52 risks) covers threats, vulnerabilities, likelihood and impact, with an annual update cycle

title: Control assessment: vulnerability monitoring
source_system: Scan reports Q1-Q2 2026; all 41 critical findings; container registry settings
what_it_shows: Quarterly authenticated scans with automated tooling and analysis; container images not scanned; 9 of 41 critical findings exceeded the 30-day target (longest 74 days)

title: Control assessment: external system services
source_system: Vendor list; sample of 20 of 64 vendor contracts; SOC 2 reports on file
what_it_shows: 13 of 20 sampled contracts have no security requirements; the credentialing vendor has no SOC 2 report; AI vendors are on click-through terms with no data use or deletion terms; no defined controls or ongoing monitoring for providers; vendor owners are named

title: Control assessment: boundary protection
source_system: Firewall and SD-WAN segment exports; reachability test from a kiosk at Branch 9 to staff laptops and printers
what_it_shows: External interfaces monitored and controlled; kiosks share the staff network at 9 of 14 branches; the Branch 9 kiosk test reached staff laptops and printers; kiosk-to-staff traffic not monitored at those branches

title: Control assessment: protection of information at rest
source_system: Encryption settings for SaaS, warehouse, archive and backups; device encryption report (30 of 30 sampled laptops)
what_it_shows: All sampled stores and devices encrypted at rest

title: Control assessment: flaw remediation
source_system: Patch reports; container image build history; clock firmware versions
what_it_shows: Laptop patches identified, reported and installed; container base images last rebuilt 2025-11; 4 of 12 clocks on firmware 2 versions behind, with no testing or schedule for clock firmware; critical updates not installed within 30 days for 9 of 41 findings

title: Control assessment: system monitoring
source_system: MSSP use case list; SIEM sources; escalation test
what_it_shows: Endpoint, identity, network and cloud monitoring operate 24x7; unauthorized use of SaaS (exports, bank changes, bulk downloads) cannot be identified; monitoring was not increased after the 2026 H1 pay diversion trend

title: Control assessment: information management and retention
source_system: Records inventory; ATS, archive, credentialing and recording platform retention settings; file-share search
what_it_shows: No retention schedule in use; I-9s, consumer reports, credential files and recordings kept since 2012 (recordings since 2022); warehouse extracts with full SSNs kept in 14 file-share folders with no end date

title: Control assessment: supplier assessments and reviews
source_system: SOC 2 reports on file; vendor review records
what_it_shows: No supplier assessments or reviews recorded before the P09 reviews; no tiering
